Why petrol, diesel prices stayed stable in India 
 inshorts inshorts Why petrol, diesel prices stayed stable in India
 Petrol and diesel prices rose by 50-60% in several countries amid global energy disruptions, but India avoided a comparable retail increase by cutting central excise duties and absorbing part of the crude oil price shock, Union Petroleum Minister Hardeep Singh Puri said.
